name: Lü Wei-lao
bio: Lü Wei-lao (呂渭老; Lü Weilao; 12th century) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 薄幸 (Bo xing)
poems.author: Lü Wei-lao
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
青楼春晚。
昼寂寂、梳匀又懒。
乍听得、鸦啼莺弄，惹起新愁无限。
记年时、偷掷春心，花间隔雾遥相见。
便角枕题诗，宝钗贳酒，共醉青苔深院。
怎忘得、回廊下，携手处、花明月满。
如今但暮雨，蜂愁蝶恨，小窗闲对芭蕉展。
却谁拘管。
尽无言、闲品秦筝，泪满参差雁。
腰支渐小，心与杨花共远。
